title: Programming fundamentals: arrays and sub-programs
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Array yard
objectives: know how one- and two-dimensional arrays are declared, read and changed
understand why arrays are zero-indexed and how a loop iterates over one
know the difference between a procedure and a function, and between local and global variables
starter: A program records the number of items in each of five crates. Write down why an array is a better choice than five separate variables, and write the line that would declare it.

stations.name: One-dimensional arrays
stations.challenge: Explain why one array is better than five separate variables for storing five crate weights.

logic.title: In the OCR Exam Reference Language, what does  array crate[5]  declare?
What is the main advantage of using one array instead of ten separate variables?

stations.name: Index positions
stations.challenge: An array holds eight marks. Give the index of the first mark and the index of the last.

logic.title: Using zero-indexing, what is the index of the last element of  array crate[5] ?
crate[2] holds 31. What does  crate[2] = 7  do?

stations.name: Two-dimensional arrays
stations.challenge: A noughts and crosses board is stored as  array board[3,3].  Give the two indices of the centre square.

logic.title: In the OCR Exam Reference Language, what does  array bay[3,4]  declare?
Which element is the centre square of  array board[3,3] ?

stations.name: Procedures and functions
stations.challenge: Decide whether printing a welcome banner and working out an average should each be a procedure or a function, and say why.

logic.title: What is the difference between a procedure and a function?
A sub-program works out the area of a rectangle so the answer can be used in a later calculation. Which should it be?

stations.name: Parameters and returns
stations.challenge: Write a function in the OCR Exam Reference Language that takes two marks as parameters and returns their average.

logic.title: In  function average(a, b),  what are a and b?
A function is defined as  function average(a, b) return (a + b) / 2 endfunction.  What does  print(average(12, 18))  output?

stations.name: Local and global
stations.fact: A local variable... A global variable...
stations.challenge: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of making a player's score a global variable.

logic.title: Where can a local variable be used?
Why do programmers use local variables wherever they can?

final.title: Final challenge: total the crates
final.instr: number the steps in the right order.

logic.title: Why does the loop count up to 4 rather than up to 5?

keyq: How does one name hold many values, and how is code broken into reusable pieces?
exam: An array is declared as  array scores[6].  State the index of the first element and the index of the last element.
Explain the difference between a procedure and a function.
A program stores five crate weights in  array crate[5].  Write an algorithm that outputs the total of all five weights, using the OCR Exam Reference Language or a language you know.
confidence: How a one- and a two-dimensional array are declared and used
Why arrays start at index 0, and how to loop over one
Procedures, functions, parameters, return values and local versus global variables
